categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Scripts and tools' label and modifies contrib/seeds/makeseeds.py.
categories.rationale: Fixes an IndexError in seed generation when parsing malformed lines with exactly 11 fields. While seed generation is an important release process, reviewers note that encountering exactly 11 fields is an edge case and corrupt input is already rare, making this a low-severity correctness fix.
